question: Which Rudras, Yakshas, Vasus, and mountain does Krishna name?
premises: he is vitteśa among yakṣas and rākṣasas
inference: Krishna names himself through chief deities and the supreme mountain.
plain_english: Among Rudras I am Śaṅkara; among Yakṣas and Rākṣasas I am the lord of wealth; among Vasus I am fire; among peaks I am Meru.
